(3) The boiled baby corn is shown being drained in a metal sieve over a glass bowl. (7) The coated baby corn is arranged on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and slid into a lit oven. (8) Final close-up of the finished grilled baby corn, glistening with sauce and sesame seeds, presented on a green plate.
